All22 revised-PDF and21 older-DOCX pages reused from personal solutions43 reading after checking exact source identity and all43 rendered PNG SHA256 matches; fresh DOCX PDF export metadata differs but page bytes do not. Revised PDF primary; older key remains explicitly supplementary, including its unrelated proton-fusion task13 document note. English Q12 specifies kinetic energy and matches supplied key (unlike distinct Bulgarian edition). All original IDs and English statements preserved. Revised source restores Q2, final-data Q10, both corrected Io13 methods and Q15 missing equations. Printed mathematical disagreements retained as recorded in prior solutions43 evidence; no invented corrections or separate model checker.
